RZ09-0509 BIOS carrier contains distinct SSID1A58300B BIOS1.04 and SSID1A58300C BIOS1.06 images. The official article distinguishes RTX4070 from RTX4080/4090. These are updater targets, not new OpenBlade SKU admission gates.

RZ09-0529 has separate BIOS4.01,EC1.06 and MCU1.07 carriers. No new general firmware minimum is inferred from update availability.

batterySetterAcknowledgement.vendorContract: The exact command helpers return successful SET status with an optional response payload; the parser populates JSON only when response bytes are present. Echo is not mandatory.
batterySetterAcknowledgement.openBladeContract: Accept zero bytes or one optional state byte without requiring an echo; the ACK is not confirmation. Require an independent exact requested raw07/92 value. Retry only the exact pre-write raw value, at most nine reads with 250ms between reads. Other mismatches, invalid or failed reads, cancellation and uncertain submission pause writes without setter replay. This bounded software tolerance does not establish physical firmware latency.
